messages:
samir: Heads-up — Bluecrest private cutover dry-run failed to deliver several VPC Flow + CloudTrail bundles to their SIEM. Cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can infra/sec triage? @quentin @harpreet :eyes:

olga: Is this full-loss or intermittent? We need to know for the CSM note — renewal review in 3 weeks so this is a material risk if >24h gap.

quentin: Quick triage: our forwarder assumes their cross-account role then PUTs SSE-KMS to their S3. Replayed a PutObject and CloudTrail shows kms:GenerateDataKey -> AccessDenied for the customer's key. Repro:```aws s3 cp ping.json s3://bluecrest-logs-test/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555566667777:key/klm-000
An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the PutObject operation: Access Denied```

harpreet: Likely key policy condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID or aws:SourceAccount) is blocking us. Proposed minimal fix: add single Allow for our forwarder role, actions GenerateDataKey+Encrypt, scope to key ARN + SourceArn, include CSR tag and scheduled revert. I'll review policy snippet and sign off.

samir: ETA and mitigation options? We need something to tell the customer quickly.

quentin: Plan: 1) draft minimal policy snippet and test in staging (ETA 30–45m) 2) if staging passes, request CSR and prod patch (ETA prod roll 2h after approvals) 3) fallback: enable Redwood-managed key for forwarder + note to customer (short-lived). I'll own steps 1–2.

olga: Draft customer blurb for CSMs (keep short): "Update: pre-cutover tests found your KMS policy prevented Redwood's log-forwarder from encrypting some audit bundles. We're validating a scoped policy patch in staging and can either roll the prod patch during the maintenance window or temporarily enable a Redwood-managed key while we validate. Expect status update within 3 hours." Add renewal-watch: escalate to AMs if >24h.

harpreet: Proposed minimal policy (will tighten Resource to exact key ARN before change):```{ "Sid":"AllowBluecrestForwarder", "Effect":"Allow", "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/log-forwarder"}, "Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Encrypt"], "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555566667777:key/klm-000", "Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"555566667777","aws:SourceArn":"arn:aws:s3:::bluecrest-logs-*","aws:RequestTag/CSR":"CSR-8898"}}}```I will add an ExpiresAt tag and schedule revert.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: forwarder-staging config update (job 9987). ETA ~18m.

quentin: Staging run: PutObject + GenerateDataKey succeeded; CloudTrail shows success. Pushed CSR-8898 for prod change with audit tag.

harpreet: Security review: approve with conditions — exact key ARN, principal locked to forwarder role, SourceAccount + SourceArn enforced, CSR tag required, revert scheduled in 2h unless customer requests permanency. No wildcard Resource.

samir: Great. Olga — send CS update now with the two options and the runbook link https://redwood-internal/onboard/bluecrest. Emphasize the revert/safety controls.

olga: Sending now. Message: "Root cause: KMS policy blocked Redwood's forwarder. Mitigation: scoped policy patch (staging-pass) OR temporary Redwood-managed key. Action: prod patch in maintenance window; we'll update after rollout. Renewal-watch flagged."

audit-bot: CSR created: CSR-8898. Change window requested: 2h. Ticket: infra/CSR-8898.

quentin: Prod patch scheduled and applied (rolling, no downtime). Post-deploy tests show PutObject + GenerateDataKey success and CI logs show audit bundles flowing to SIEM.

harpreet: Post-change check: verified CloudTrail entries for successful GenerateDataKey and PutObject. Revert scheduled but will cancel revert if customer approves permanence.

samir: Owner:quentin, blocker:resolved-in-staging->prod, next: customer signoff for permanent policy (if requested). Renewal-watch: AMs notified. :white_check_mark:
